# Introduction

This file is used to conduct basic correlation analysis on recreational fishers in the 2025 SELTMP data. Pearson's and Spearman's Analysis are conducted between 

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# R Setup & housekeeping
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	echo = TRUE,
	include = TRUE,
	message = FALSE,
	warning = FALSE)

rm(list=ls())
objects()
```

```{r}
# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ordinal)   # clm() for models and nominal_test()
library(MASS)      # polr() for Brant test
library(brant)     # Brant test for proportional odds
library(car)       # Model comparisons and diagnostics
library(emmeans)   # Marginal means if needed
```

# 1. Prepare data

```{r}
# Import Raw Data sheet
raw_data <- read_excel(here::here("Data/SELTMP-2025-GBR-surveydataset_v1-0_RecFishingCLUSTERS_RyanW-Oct-22-2026.xlsx"), sheet = "Raw_Data")

#glimpse(raw_data)
```

```{r}
# Filter Data for only Rec Fishers
fisher_data <- raw_data |>
  filter(!is.na(inter_zoning), Are_you_a_Rec_Fisher == "1")
```
